Standard: The on-off, failures, and mode status of the steering system are indicated to the flight crew. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review displays to verify system status is provided. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct ground demonstration to verify indication system informs the flight crew when system is engaged, disengaged, and mode status. Steering system engages and disengages when flight crew input command is given or automatically based on control system inputs. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Simulator testing verifies system design logic and indication of the steering system status.
